features.name: Agent Runtime
features.description: The foundation layer for agents in Business Central that includes the underlying data model for storing agent tasks, the agent task execution engine, and supporting functions like timeline view data preparation.

features.name: Agent SDK
features.description: A layer that allows developers to build custom agent applications on top of the agent runtime components.

features.name: Logical Client API
features.description: A JSON-based API that provides information about the current page including fields, actions, and tooltips. This API was originally designed for rendering pages across Windows client, web, and mobile platforms, and is now reused for agents to interact with Business Central.
caveats: Pre-existing technology not originally designed for AI

features.name: Agent Memory System
features.description: A memory mechanism that maintains context across agent operations, remembering visited pages, search results, and allowing agents to write notes for later reference in subsequent prompts.
caveats: Memory is partial and included in subsequent prompts

features.name: Execute Task Prompt
features.description: The core prompt that directs the LLM to decide what action to take next based on the current page representation, field values, and available actions. The most complex prompt in the runtime, growing dynamically as the agent performs more steps.
caveats: Dynamic growth as task progresses; highly variable in size

features.name: Input Content Analysis
features.description: Auxiliary prompts that analyze input messages to agents (such as emails) for harmful content, including violent language and attempts to bypass agent constraints or gain unauthorized data access.

features.name: Output Content Validation
features.description: Validation checks performed on agent-generated output messages to ensure correct language, proper number formatting, correct dates, and that any data in the output is grounded in information the agent has actually seen.

features.name: Grounding Validation
features.description: A technique using a separate LLM prompt to verify that generated content containing data actually matches the underlying data. This prevents hallucination by having an evaluator prompt check that output data is consistent with data the agent has seen.
caveats: Requires two LLM calls instead of one
Evaluator approach is good at matching but not perfect
Essential for ERP systems handling sensitive data like sales orders

features.name: Loop Detection in Agent Execution
features.description: A runtime mechanism that detects when an agent gets stuck repeating the same tool calls or bouncing between actions in unexpected loops. The system uses prompts to identify true loops versus expected repetitive behavior and attempts to nudge the agent to recover.
caveats: Must distinguish between expected and unexpected loops

features.name: Agent Intervention Prompts
features.description: When loop detection identifies a stuck agent, the runtime acts as the user to provide feedback like 'Hey, I think you're in a loop. This doesn't look like you're progressing. Try to get out of it.' This gives the agent a chance to self-correct before requiring human intervention.
caveats: User must intervene if agent cannot self-correct

features.name: Validation Error Recovery
features.description: When an agent sets a field with wrong format causing validation errors on pages, the runtime allows the agent to retry with different inputs. This mirrors human behavior of making mistakes, receiving errors, and trying again.

features.name: Timeline Step Grouping and Summarization
features.description: The runtime groups multiple individual agent steps into logical operations for display in the timeline. Uses a combination of deterministic rules and prompting to show coarse-grained operations like 'create sales quote' or 'sent mail' instead of every individual click and field fill.
caveats: Full granular step logs available in agent task logs but not shown by default

features.name: Agent Task Logs
features.description: Detailed logs accessible in the product that capture every step the agent performed. Users can drill into these logs to see the complete execution trace, though this detailed view is not the default display experience.

features.name: Multiple Prompts in Agent Runtime
features.description: The agent runtime uses approximately 20 different prompts for various functions beyond the main task execution. These range from simple small prompts for simple tasks to complex dynamic prompts, handling grounding, validation, loop detection, timeline grouping, and other control flow.
caveats: Number has grown over time; includes prompts of varying complexity

features.name: Multi-Model Runtime Strategy
features.description: The agent runtime uses multiple LLM models optimized for different tasks. Simpler prompts use mini versions of model families for speed and cost, while complex prompts like execute task use full-size models for better quality, despite being slower.
caveats: Requires testing each prompt with mini versions to ensure capability

features.name: Mini vs Full Model Evaluation
features.description: The runtime evaluates whether smaller mini versions of language models can handle each prompt's requirements. Tasks like summarization and grounding can often run on mini models, which are considerably faster and cheaper than full models.
caveats: Each prompt must have tests covering scenarios where it's expected to work

features.name: Reasoning Model Evaluation for Agent Execution
features.description: The team evaluated reasoning models (GPT-o1 and GPT-5 with reasoning) for the execute task prompt but found they introduced significant latency increases. For multi-step agent execution, the improved reasoning did not provide sufficient accuracy benefits to justify the performance cost.
caveats: Constantly re-evaluating as new models arrive; reasoning effort levels can be tweaked

features.name: Dynamic Model Selection Strategy
features.description: The runtime may eventually use a hybrid approach where reasoning is applied selectively for certain steps while using faster, cheaper small models for others, optimizing latency and cost across multi-step agent execution.
caveats: Under evaluation; depends on LLM landscape which moves rapidly

features.name: Agent Scenario-Based Testing Framework
features.description: A testing system that spins up agents with specific instructions based on scenarios, runs them against test data, and validates outcomes against expectations. Tests are split into accuracy tests for regular scenarios and challenge tests for complex situations where the runtime currently struggles.
caveats: Tests do not verify exact steps, only that goals are reached
Challenge test results vary by model and prompt

features.name: Model-Specific Prompt Tuning
features.description: When switching to a new model, the team tweaks prompts to ensure existing tests continue passing. Different model versions may require prompt adjustments for validation, execute task, or other functions to maintain compatibility.
caveats: No model upgrade has allowed completely in-place updates without any modifications
Adjustments are typically small wording changes, not complete rewrites

features.name: MCP Tools Integration for Agents
features.description: Agent developers can give agents extra tools using MCP, the common standard nowadays, to enhance agent capabilities when building custom agents.
caveats: Still in evaluation phase for effectiveness
Needs testing to verify it actually improves accuracy

features.name: Cross-Task Memory for Agents
features.description: A feature being explored that allows agents to remember feedback and corrections across different tasks, so if an agent makes a mistake or needs help, it does not need to ask for the same help again on subsequent tasks. Also referred to as teaching.
caveats: Mechanism for when to remember is still TBD
Could use a checkbox when providing feedback or automatic decision
Currently only remembers within a single task

features.name: Agent Knowledge Base Integration
features.description: Agents will be able to consult external knowledge bases like Microsoft Learn and BC documentation to find answers without asking the user. Similar to how Copilot chat can query knowledge bases for BC documentation and instructions.
caveats: Still being evaluated for whether it actually helps
Needs testing in challenge test scenarios before deployment

features.name: Agent Accuracy Improvements
features.description: Ongoing work to improve agent decision-making while maintaining existing test accuracy. The team runs multiple test cases across two built agents to ensure changes do not regress existing functionality.
caveats: Changes may impact other scenarios
Requires careful testing
Balance needed between improvement and regression prevention

features.name: Tool Integration Feature
features.description: New types of features for agent tools that would include UI elements and be documented in release notes, providing visible changes to users.
